Risk_Title: Unauthorized Access or Privilege Abuse on Core Ledger & Databases at Onix
Threat_and_Vulnerability_Description: Compromised administrative credentials weak RBAC or unpatched core/database components at Onix Data Centre allow unauthorized viewing or alteration of wallet/deposit/credit/ledger data.
Risk_Owner: Head of Core Systems / Engineering Lead
Planned_or_Existing_Controls: Enforce role-based access control (RBAC) privileged access management (PAM) MFA encryption at rest/in transit timely patching and immutable audit logging

Risk_Title: Tamale Backup Server Failure or Unverified Restore During Outage
Threat_and_Vulnerability_Description: Encrypted backup server in Tamale suffers hardware failure corruption or power/cooling issue and backups fail restore testing when needed for recovery.
Planned_or_Existing_Controls: Schedule automated encrypted backups maintain UPS and generator power run quarterly restore drills and store off-site/secondary verification logs

Risk_Title: Extended Connectivity and Power Disruption at Tamale Office
Threat_and_Vulnerability_Description: MTN primary internet fails or degrades and Starlink failover or UPS/generator cutover is delayed or runs out of fuel during power outages in Tamale.
Planned_or_Existing_Controls: Configure automated MTN-to-Starlink failover monitor link health maintain UPS batteries and generator fuel reserves and test failover semi-annually

Risk_Title: Field Agent Device Theft Loss or Misuse of Customer KYC/Cash Data
Threat_and_Vulnerability_Description: Field agent mobile device is lost stolen or used improperly exposing customer PII/KYC data or initiating unauthorized onboarding/collection actions.
Planned_or_Existing_Controls: Enforce Mobile Device Management (MDM) remote wipe strong PIN/biometrics minimal offline caching session timeouts and agent activity monitoring

Risk_Title: USSD Channel Outage or Session/Transaction Mismatch
Threat_and_Vulnerability_Description: USSD provider experiences downtime or session timeouts/retries cause duplicate or failed wallet/deposit/credit transaction prompts.
Planned_or_Existing_Controls: Implement idempotency keys strict session timeouts automated transaction reconciliation alerts SLAs and fallback communication notices

Risk_Title: Accidental Upload of Restricted or Sensitive Data to Microsoft 365
Threat_and_Vulnerability_Description: Staff upload customer PII credit/KYC records or sensitive financial data into Microsoft 365 violating the M365 non-sensitive use only boundary.
Planned_or_Existing_Controls: Enforce M365 non-sensitive use only policy Data Loss Prevention (DLP) labels/rules phishing-resistant MFA Conditional Access and staff training

Risk_Title: API or Web/Mobile Application Vulnerability Exploitation
Threat_and_Vulnerability_Description: Flaws in mobile app APIs or web portal (such as broken auth injection or weak session handling) enable account takeover or fraudulent transactions.
Planned_or_Existing_Controls: Conduct secure code reviews API rate limiting input validation TLS enforcement and independent penetration testing with remediation SLAs

Risk_Title: Phishing or Malware Infection on Staff Workstations and Office LAN
Threat_and_Vulnerability_Description: Staff or remote workers fall victim to phishing or unsegmented LAN/Wi-Fi exposes internal administrative paths and workstations to malware.
Planned_or_Existing_Controls: Deploy phishing-resistant MFA EDR full-disk encryption VLAN segmentation guest Wi-Fi isolation and recurring phishing/security awareness training

Risk_Title: Unauthorized Disclosure of Vulnerability or Architecture Data by Security Tester
Threat_and_Vulnerability_Description: Independent security tester retains or leaks sensitive architecture details or vulnerability reports due to weak engagement controls.
Planned_or_Existing_Controls: Require signed NDA strict rules of engagement scoped test accounts/data and verified post-test data deletion or secure return

Risk_Title: Third-Party Supplier Disruption or SLA Failure (Onix MTN Starlink USSD)
Threat_and_Vulnerability_Description: Key supplier experiences major outage or unannounced infrastructure change disrupting PayNest services without timely notice.
Planned_or_Existing_Controls: Maintain vendor due diligence clear SLAs incident notification clauses multi-path connectivity (MTN + Starlink) and continuity playbooks

Risk_Title: Unchecked Code Release or Loss of a Key Developer
Threat_and_Vulnerability_Description: With one front-end and one back-end developer unreviewed code could reach live systems or critical knowledge and access could be lost if either is unavailable.
Planned_or_Existing_Controls: Peer code review and automated scanning release by an IT officer controlled source code repository separate environments documentation and cross-training
